dbnn.model_definition: Full quadratic W including trainable diagonal

training_config.optimizer: NAdam, epsilon 1e-7, momentum_decay .004; reset each stage
training_config.loss: BCE + soma MSE + whitened dendritic-PCA MSE, default five-stage weight schedule + kernel L2 1e-8
training_config.recipe: Author fit_CNN.py schedule, generator length 6*int(.2*128*6000/(8*400))=288 batches/epoch. Published seven-layer NMDA TCN architecture; no capacity search. This labeled boundary control excludes initial150ms from every output loss; the author-default run is preserved separately.
adaptations: 500 fixed E/I input IDs instead of NeuronIO 1278 inputs; exact event multiplicity retained
Physical 400/500ms windows and 150/154ms overlaps retained; ELM delta_t adjusted; TCN kernels discretized to retain 152ms physical context
Corresponding DBNN fit/validation events; no main31 data in training, PCA or selection
Original output moment alignment replaced by one validation-fitted affine map, locked before held-out evaluation; raw results retained
For this prespecified boundary-condition control only, all output losses exclude initial150ms; no validation/test hyperparameter search.
training_config.fairness_control: Shared150ms loss burn-in; model, initializer, author optimizer/schedule/budget and sampling unchanged. Original author-default results retained separately.

voltage_calibration.source: Complete validation set, clipped voltage after initial 500ms; never main31

protocol.threshold_calibration_data: Original validation set; reused without new selection
